title: Account
deepIntro: Used for explained suggestions. No attachment-style labels or self-scored EQ.
privacyHint: Matching does not use precise GPS. Location is an approximate area only.
aiConsentHint: Each AI task needs an explicit tick. Revoke anytime — private journals and raw chat are never used by default.
accountIntro: Security, sessions, notifications, and data requests. Block/report are never behind a paywall.
billingSuccess: Payment succeeded — your plan activates after Stripe webhook confirmation.
billingCancel: Checkout cancelled. You were not charged.
sessionsHint: Device management appears when the session API is ready.
notificationsHint: Email/push preferences — message content is never shown on notifications.
dataHint: Export / delete data per the published policy.
legalHubHint: Open policies, privacy choices, support, subscriptions, and account deletion.
deleteSubscriptionNote: Deleting your account does not cancel store-managed subscriptions. Manage them in the store where you purchased.
historyIntro: Your mutual matches, couples, and bookings. Private journals are not used for ranking.
historyEmptyBody: When you have mutual matches or couple activity, they appear here.
avatarHint: JPEG/PNG/WebP · max 8MB · stored privately in the media bucket
avatarTypeError: Only JPEG, PNG, or WebP are accepted.
deleteConfirmPrompt: Type DELETE to confirm permanent deletion.
deleteWarning: Deleting your account removes personal data per our published policy. This cannot be undone.
